text.p: Dominion Bond Rating Service said on Friday it confirmed secured debentures, series A of Markborough Properties Inc at BBB and convertible subordinated debentures of Cambridge Shopping Centres Ltd at BBB.
The Toronto-based ratings agency said the ratings for both companies carry stable trends.
DBRS also said it put Cadillac Fairview's notional rating at BBB with a stable trend.

DBRS said that it expected all three real estate managers to feel the impact of a restructuring at T. Eaton Co Ltd, which filed for bankruptcy protection on Thursday under the Companies' Creditors Arrangement Act (CCAA).
The historic retailer leases stores in five of Markborough's shopping centers, but DBRS expected only one to be closed, so exposure was minimal.
Eaton's also leases in 12 Cambridge malls, but DBRS expected only four of those to be closed, with just one considered a re-leasing challenge.
"Consequently, the overall effect of the Eaton's announcement on Cambridge is considered to be small," DBRS said.

Dominion said that most of the 17 Eaton's stores leased from Cadillac Fairview were in well-recognized, highly profitable shopping centers, so the overall effect of possible store closings was considered "manageable."
